question: What is the essential nature of the light that shines as awareness?
premises: Awareness is connected with the nature of light.
Because of that connection, it is essentially dense with conscious reflective awareness.
The light that shines has reflective awareness as its own nature.
inference: Therefore the shining of light is inseparable from self-reflective consciousness.
plain_english: Because it is of the nature of light, awareness is essentially dense with conscious self-reflection; and that light which shines has reflective awareness as its very nature.
